ValidationRule.description: For Tech Team tickets, the field Resolution is required to close a ticket
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: and( or( ispickval(Type__c, "Solutions: Salesforce & Data"), ispickval(Type__c, "Solutions: Onsite IT & Tech Support" )), ispickval( Status__c , "Closed"), Isblank( Resolution__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add a resolution to close the ticket!
